baseline_validation_before_execution: Require C1.5-A full_storage COMPLETED, primary_result_eligible=true, 2616 completed pairs and zero failures
Hash capture/reconstruction/environment, profile manifest and profile binaries, full-storage manifests, raw rows and summary; bind references in a new B execution manifest without editing A
Select stratum=T=10 from c15_full_summary.csv for UNIFORM_INT8/GLOBAL/LAYERGROUP; verify 236 unique T10 block IDs and matching raw rows
Reconcile raw/payload/local bytes and charge each full shared profile once for T10 as A does; do not amortize A profiles over 1308 while charging B over 236
Verify C1 CUDA replay and saved reconstruction hashes before B symbols are analyzed
Keep unknown completed-artifact hashes null until actual files are available; local placeholder hashes are not completion evidence
invariants: C1/C1.5-A artifacts and profile hashes unchanged
C1 CUDA quantization/reconstruction and original FP32 scale values unchanged in lossless arm
B1: no arithmetic coding, CDF construction or profile fitting. Coding plans apply only to a separately authorized B2.
No layer-wise lossy quantization, channel-layer CDF, or physical-page redesign in initial B1/B2
No model inference or download for B1/B2
No T=10 versus mixed-T primary comparison
later_research_extension: Logical w=3 reuse with physical compression pages >=10 tokens is deferred; no T=3 transform, page redesign, C2 or GlobalQKVCache change.
local_design_source_note: Hashes identify code inspected for this design, not the unmounted SERAPH A execution implementation.
no_experiment_statement: B1 lossless symbol/locality diagnostics implemented but not run on real C1 fixtures. No B2/B3 implementation, arithmetic coding, new lossy quantization, profile fitting or inference performed.

population.calibration_rule: Only frozen calibration T=10 blocks, count/IDs/hashes resolved from actual manifest; no new partition of evaluation data.
population.expected_count_provenance: Frozen C1 distribution reported by user; verify against mounted manifest before B1/B2.
population.justification: Each T=10 fixture is one complete contiguous group; no tail rule is needed. This matches group length/anchor locality, not every paper implementation detail.
population.rule: All evaluation T=10 blocks in frozen capture-manifest order; both datasets; no sampling or result-dependent ordering.
population.scope_limit: Captured base-projection Q/K/V on short SNIPS/MultiWOZ queries differs from the paper workload. No generalization to post-position-transform cache states, long contexts, or all models is presumed.

B0.definition: Pinned upstream source and paper audit; no experiment implementation.
B0.exit_gate: On SERAPH verify actual checkout remote, exact HEAD, clean/dirty status and relevant source hashes; bind completed A baseline hashes.

B1.calibration_evaluation_statistics: Separate empirical histograms; evaluation counts describe evaluation entropy, never fit or modify a coder/profile.

config.K_V_models: separate; combine code costs, never histograms
config.arithmetic_dtype: wide Python integers; never int8 subtraction

decision_rule.go: overall reduction >= 3% AND positive reduction in both SNIPS and MultiWOZ
decision_rule.metric: evaluation K+V weighted bits/symbol, with separate K/V probability models

config.entropy: empirical Shannon, no smoothing, no CDF, no differential entropy
config.histogram_index: original s+127 for anchors/raw; centered d+127 for residuals
config.locality: float64 analysis of raw FP16: x_i-x_0; target-normalized relative L2; pooled cosine
config.residual: r=(u_i-u_0) mod 255; d=r if r<=127 else r-255; i=1..9

B1.controls: Primary comparison ANCHOR_MOD_RESIDUAL vs RAW_ROLE_SPLIT; RAW_GLOBAL additionally measures role-modeling benefit. Pool across layers; do not silently pool K/V.
B1.correctness: Exact inverse symbols and unchanged FP32 scales for all blocks; exact direct CUDA reconstruction; exact saved-C1 reconstruction for evaluation blocks (calibration references were not saved by C1). Q untouched FP16.

decision_rule.go: overall reduction >= 3% AND positive reduction in both SNIPS and MultiWOZ
decision_rule.metric: evaluation K+V weighted bits/symbol, with separate K/V probability models

B1.definition: T=10 only; unchanged C1 CUDA quantization; RAW_GLOBAL, RAW_ROLE_SPLIT and ANCHOR_MOD_RESIDUAL with separate K/V probability models.
B1.go: overall reduction >= 3% AND positive reduction in both SNIPS and MultiWOZ
metrics: 255-bin integer counts and unique symbols per component/role
empirical Shannon entropy and actual-symbol-count-weighted family cost
percentage reduction vs RAW_GLOBAL and RAW_ROLE_SPLIT
K/V separate and count-weighted K+V costs across separate models
raw FP16 float64-analysis mean absolute delta, RMS, target-normalized relative L2 and pooled cosine by distance 1..9
B1.no_quality_change: Exact inverse preserves original C1 symbols and scales; reconstruction unchanged.
B1.protocol_supersedes: B0 provisional B1 design: user now specifies separately reported empirical calibration/evaluation entropy and an evaluation 3% practical screening rule. No held-out cross-entropy fitting, signed-509-alphabet arm or new profiles in B1.
B1.selection_policy: All frozen T=10 calibration and evaluation blocks, with calibration processed first. Transform/alphabet/grouping/3% decision rule frozen before loading any fixtures. Never tune from evaluation.
B1.stop: Otherwise STOP; any inverse/parity/coverage/input-contract failure invalidates the run.

B2.accounting: Actual produced payload bytes + all local metadata + one serialized shared profile set per independent pool; Q charged uncompressed. Include any transform header/alphabet/role metadata. Never derive primary sizes from entropy.

arms.definition: Read exact T=10 C1 UNIFORM_INT8, A GLOBAL and A LAYERGROUP rows and summary; no rebenchmark or refit.
arms.name: A_FROZEN_CONTROLS

arms.definition: Untransformed C1 symbols, new T=10-calibration-only GLOBAL CDFs. Controls for A profiles having pooled T=3 and T=10 calibration.
arms.name: B_RAW_T10_FIT_CONTROL

arms.definition: Same C1 symbols/scales, CDF count, fitting population, coder and byte accounting as B_RAW_T10_FIT_CONTROL; only reversible symbol representation differs.
arms.name: B_MOD255_T10_FIT

B2.definition: Lossless anchor-relative symbol encoding plus fixed shared entropy coding, isolated from new lossy quantization.
B2.evaluation: One encode/decode storage/correctness pass per pending T=10 block/arm; all 236 blocks; deterministic resumable checkpoints. No repeated latency benchmark.
exactness: inverse transform restores original C1 symbols
B2.optional_later_ablation: If justified, compare raw-role-split vs mod255-role-split using four CDFs (anchor-K/V and delta-or-nonanchor-K/V); do not attribute this extra profile capacity to the transform alone. Layer-group/channel-layer variants deferred.
B2.profiles: New B-only calibration-derived profiles, frozen before evaluation. Initial pooling is GLOBAL: separate K/V, all layers and both token roles pooled, same model capacity as A GLOBAL.
B2.recommended_transform: Centered modulo-255 of original C1 symbols after quantization; explicit RESEARCH_EXTENSION, not official CacheGen delta semantics.
B2.stop: Any correctness/coverage/accounting failure; or no positive total storage saving. Never reinterpret lossless failure as acceptable lossy behavior.
B2.success: Positive full stored-byte reduction versus B_RAW_T10_FIT_CONTROL establishes transform benefit. Report reductions versus each frozen A T=10 control separately; only beating A LAYERGROUP establishes improvement over the strongest measured A T=10 control.

comparisons: FP anchor/delta + unchanged C1 quantizer (Option 1, separate lossy arm)
B3.definition: Separately investigate floating-value anchor/delta with layer-wise quantization only if earlier evidence and quality goals justify it.
B3.go: Only after explicit study design and preregistered quality bounds; B3 is unnecessary if lossless B2 already answers the question.
prerequisites: Resolve and document delta sign/dtype/predictor/rounding choices
Obtain an authoritative fractional-bin formula or label a chosen integer-bin schedule as an OPT reproduction choice, not source-verified equivalence
Register quantization schedules and quality acceptance limits before evaluation
Keep probability-model granularity fixed while changing quantization; channel-layer CDF requires another ablation
quality_metrics: K/V max absolute error, relative L2 and cosine against original FP16 and C1
separate future task/logit quality study: KL, argmax agreement and task metrics under registered tolerances
B3.stop: Unresolved semantics or unacceptable quality tradeoff. No B3 inference is authorized or run by this audit.

user_reported_c15a.use: Context only. Overall ratios are not T=10 controls.
